text: This stretch of Tichester Road and Heath Street West is heavily travelled by both motorists and pedestrians. The buildings along these roads are home to a high percentage of seniors and two schools are accessed via this route. Also located here is the north entrance to St. Clair West subway which attracts pedestrians from neighbourhoods in all directions. Residents have raised repeat safety concerns for pedestrians along the corridor and since traffic incidents are reduced at lower speeds, this stretch of road should be reduced to 30km/h.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on Tichester Road and Heath Street West, between Bathurst Street and a point 41 metres west of Spadina Road, from 40km/h to 30km/h. 2. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on Heath Street West, between a point 41 metres west of Spadina Road to Spadina Road, from 50km/h to 30km/h.
